title: Peak-hour gridlock at Inorbit junction
description: Severe congestion every evening from 5 PM to 9 PM near Inorbit Mall. Vehicles take 20+ minutes to cross one junction.

title: Hazy air and dust on HITEC City roads
description: Dust and vehicle exhaust make it hard to breathe along the service roads during office opening and closing times.

title: Signal cycle too long causing spillback
description: The Cyber Towers signal holds traffic too long on one arm causing queues to spill back onto the main carriageway.

title: Frequent power cuts in Financial District
description: Premises in Gachibowli Financial District face 2 to 3 outages each week especially during load-shedding cycles and monsoon.

title: Transformer humming and sparking near residential block
description: Residents report a distribution transformer that hums loudly and shows sparks during peak evening load.

title: Metro feeder buses miss stops in peak hours
description: Massive rush at metro feeder stops; buses skip crowded stops during peak, forcing people to use personal vehicles.

title: Mother Dairy waste bins overflowing
description: Kukatpally market waste bins overflow for two days before collection, spilling into the drain.

title: Waterlogged underpass after rain
description: The underpass near Kukatpally gets waterlogged after every moderate rain causing long detours.

title: Street lights dark on Begumpet service road
description: A stretch of 400 m on the Begumpet service road has working street lights only on one side creating unsafe conditions.

title: Air quality poor near Old City during market hours
description: Charminar market area sees thick smoke and dust during rush hours; many shopkeepers complaining of breathing issues.

title: Garbage pile up near heritage monument
description: Uncollected garbage near the Charminar periphery is affecting the heritage precinct and sanitation.

title: Footpath encroachments on HITEC City Main Road
description: Footpaths on HITEC City Main Road are blocked by vendors and parked two wheelers forcing pedestrians onto the carriageway.

title: High peak demand tripping in summer
description: Gachibowli residential feeders trip on hot afternoons when air conditioning demand peaks; residents face repeated interruptions.

title: Dangerous right-turn movement at Gachibowli junction
description: Right-turning traffic from the Miyapur arm conflicts with straight through flow; several near misses reported by auto drivers.

title: Misaligned lane markings confuse drivers
description: KPHB road lane markings have faded after resurfacing; vehicles change lanes unsafely near the bus depot.

title: Secondary road dust after construction
description: Construction dust along the Gachibowli to Kondapur stretch causes low visibility in the evening.

title: Public bus frequency low on Inner Ring Road
description: Buses on the Gachibowli Inner Ring Road arrive every 25 minutes in the evening; commuters wait long.

title: Drains blocked with silt near market
description: Kukatpally market drains are silted and overflow during rain; mosquito breeding reported.

title: Need EV charging on HITEC City service road
description: Residents request public EV charging points along the HITEC City service roads as adoption rises.

title: Old city transformer frequent fuse-off
description: Charminar area experiences daily fuse-off and partial outages; the local distribution transformer appears undersized.
